### 3 Helpful Challenges in the Story of the Widow's Mite
Author: Rev. Kyle Norman
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/helpful-challenges-in-the-story-of-the-widows-mite.html
Passage: Mark 12:41-44
Points:
- True faith values humble devotion over grand, public displays of religious performance.
- God evaluates the heart's commitment rather than the numerical size of an offering.
- Genuine giving involves entrusting oneself to God rather than offering only convenient leftovers.
- Believers are challenged to care for the vulnerable instead of chasing earthly, institutional glory.
